newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arafat orders arrests of militants -PLO official.
newsitem.headline: Arafat orders arrests of militants -PLO official.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat ordered the arrest of members of militant Moslem groups on Wednesday following a double suicide bombing that killed 14 people in a Jerusalem market, a PLO security official said.

"A state of emergency has been declared in all Palestinian areas. Arafat has ordered the arrest of activists of extremist groups, including Hamas and Islamic Jihad," the official told Reuters. "The arrests have already started."

The official, who asked not to be identified, said Arafat's Palestinian Authority did not have firm information about which group was responsible for the twin bombings in Jerusalem's crowded Mahane Yehuda market.
He said Arafat was convening an emergency security meeting in the wake of the attack.
Visiting wounded in hospital, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu accused Arafat and his self-rule administration of not doing enough to stop attacks against the Jewish state.

"We expect the Palestinian Authority and its leader to begin to fight terror as they are committed to, as they haven't done until today, that they will take all the steps required against these terrorists and their operators who roam free," Netanyahu told a news conference.
